[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 39[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321261][color=#ffffff]Monetary Contests Rule[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

A new rule has been put in place for contests. Due to an increase within the member contests section of fake giveaways, everyone who is hosting a giveaway for any monetary amount will now need to send the amount [mention=1] to hold until the end of the giveaway. This rule has been put in place to make sure that the giveaway is legit and should help the fake giveaways seen over the last few months. We have seen quite a few hosting the news each week and are glad to see this put in place to help combat the issue we were seeing far too much of. Let us know what you think about this new rule in the replies this week.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6314337][color=#ffffff]The Hack Forums Wiki Returns[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=2331053]

As a lot of you know by now, the wiki was taken over by the team behind the HF News. We are happy to announce more work has been completed on bringing the wiki up to date, and we have been actively updating it over the last few months. The site is at a stage where we are happy to say it's pretty much complete or near to it as this thread may age. We will be updating the community on the changes made and updates that have gone on within the mentioned thread, and we hope to see you all on the wiki to find out whatever you are interested in soon.

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]The Silent Impact of Dehydration[/size][/b][/color]  

Many young adults don’t realize how mild dehydration can affect the body. Even a small drop in hydration levels can lead to fatigue, headaches, poor concentration, and reduced physical performance. Drinking enough water also supports digestion, circulation, and temperature regulation. Health experts suggest drinking water regularly throughout the day, especially during work, exercise, or hot weather. Staying hydrated is one of the simplest ways to maintain energy and overall health.

[hr]

[color=#00369B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]  

Stop waiting for motivation. Discipline and routine are far more reliable. Create small daily habits and stick to them, even on days you don't feel like it. Over time, those small actions build powerful results.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321724]😆 100,000 Bytes Contest 🙃 $250 Value - Upgraded Members Only (New Contest)[/url] By [mention=5418830] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

[mention=5418830] is at it again with another 100,000 bytes giveaway this month. The giveaway ends on the 1st of April 2026 this time around and is the same as the last giveaway. All you need to do is give the post a quick love, give [mention=5418830] max pop you are able to give, and reply to the thread. It is very simple for such a large number of bytes to have the chance to grab.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321967]4500 Bytes Giveaway Contest[/url] By @Nick Elite@ [/color][/size][/b][/u]

The user known as @Nick Elite@ is hosting a bytes giveaway for any upgraded member on the site. The giveaway is being hosted until the 24th of March 2026 and the steps to enter are nice and easy. They are hosting the giveaway to help start the launch of the users hosting, proxy and domain services on the site.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321287]$50 Crypto Contest || 1 Winner || Ends 31 March || LTC[/url] By [mention=516470] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

Litecoin is up for grabs with [mention=516470] newest giveaway. This giveaway has recently started and is being represented by the group "The Brotherhood" The giveaway is very easy to enter and all you need to do is make a post in the replies in the thread, give some rep, and have been a site member for at least six months. We wish everyone the best of luck with the giveaway.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321316]200$ Crypto Giveaway - CRACK THE SEED - Part 3[/url] By [mention=7] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

A little bigger giveaway has turned up from the legend himself [mention=7] this week. The giveaway is a little different to most. The giveaway is to whoever can crack the seed. Now what does this mean? We hear you ask. Well, this is like a puzzle giveaway where you will get 12 mnemonic words needed to access the wallet. The one who can complete them all wins the $200 SOL. If you think you have the skills for this, go and check out the thread for more details about how to obtain the first hints.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Nvidia prepares new AI chip announcements for GTC developer conference[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Nvidia is expected to unveil new artificial intelligence hardware, software tools and partnerships during its upcoming GTC developer conference as competition in the AI chip market intensifies.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/technology/nvidia-focus-competition-beating-ai-advances-megaconference-2026-03-13/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Meta unveils roadmap for new in house AI chips powering data centers[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Meta has revealed plans for several internally designed AI accelerators under the MTIA program to improve efficiency and reduce reliance on external chip suppliers.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/meta-unveils-plans-batch-in-house-ai-chips-2026-03-11/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]AI startup Thinking Machines secures large Nvidia chip supply agreement[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Thinking Machines Lab signed a multiyear partnership with Nvidia that includes a major investment and access to next generation processors to train large scale AI models.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/ai-startup-thinking-machines-clinches-capital-major-chip-supply-deal-nvidia-2026-03-10/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Broadcom forecasts more than one hundred billion dollars in AI chip sales[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Broadcom said demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure could push its AI chip related sales above one hundred billion dollars in the coming years.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/broadcom-rallies-it-touts-more-than-100-billion-ai-chip-sales-2027-2026-03-05/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]US government considers stricter rules for exporting advanced AI chips[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Officials are discussing new export requirements for artificial intelligence chips that could require foreign companies to increase investments inside the United States.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/us-mulls-new-rules-ai-chip-exports-including-requiring-investments-by-foreign-2026-03-05/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Nvidia CEO signals shift in strategy as AI companies prepare stock market listings[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said future large investments in companies like OpenAI may be limited as AI firms prepare for potential public listings.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/nvidia-will-not-be-able-invest-100-billion-openai-due-ipo-ceo-jensen-says-2026-03-04/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Nvidia halts production of some China targeted AI chips amid export controls[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Production of Nvidia H200 chips intended for the Chinese market has reportedly been paused as export rules and security reviews complicate international AI chip sales.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/china/nvidia-refocuses-tsmc-capacity-export-controls-stall-china-sales-ft-reports-2026-03-05/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]US develops stricter government AI contract rules amid dispute with Anthropic[/color][/size][/b][/u]
The US government is drafting new rules for civilian artificial intelligence contracts requiring companies to allow broader lawful uses of their models.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/us-draws-up-strict-new-ai-guidelines-amid-anthropic-clash-ft-reports-2026-03-07/]Source[/url][/b]
